infobox.effect: Provides 36 inventory slots while only taking up 4

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- This item is only available as a reward for players who have linked a Discord account to their game account on the Escape from Tarkov website.
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The Toolbox (Discord Version) is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 36 inventory slots in a 6x6 grid and only takes up 4 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
- Tools
- Building materials
- Paracord
- Leatherman Multitool
- Freeman crowbar
